caveats: Loss comparisons use only finite final validation logged at the exact planned final step, from independently SHA-verified archives.
CUDA reductions are nondeterministic; identical seeds can follow different trajectories. Three seeds support descriptive effects, not a significance claim.
Native timing is reported separately. Recorded training time excludes validation and checkpoint IO; wall time includes them.
LocoProp arms are sampled FC hybrids; partial replacement retains native biases and every other parameter. No quality benefit is assumed.
Solver and BF16-change summaries cover logged snapshots only, not all updates.
